```{r}
#| include: false

# To render to PDF after you've rendered your .html document:
# pagedown::chrome_print("./report.html", "./report.pdf", format = "pdf")

# We'll build this into the YAML header so you don't have to take this extra step
# once the {pagedown} people get around to adding quarto support.

library(ojodb)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(ojothemes)

ojo_set_theme(
  theme = "okpi"
)
```


```{r}
#| include: false

eviction_cases <- ojo_tbl("issue", schema = "oscn") |>
  filter(str_detect(description, "^FORC")) |>
  select(case_id) |>
  inner_join(
    ojo_tbl("case", schema = "oscn"),
    by = c("case_id" = "id")
  ) |>
  collect()

eviction_documents <- ojo_tbl("issue", schema = "oscn") |>
  filter(str_detect(description, "^FORC")) |>
  select(case_id) |>
  left_join(
    ojo_tbl("document", schema = "oscn"),
    by = "case_id"
  ) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
doc_status <- eviction_cases |>
  left_join(
    eviction_documents |>
      mutate(
        on_oscn = !is.na(url),
        collected = !is.na(internal_url)
      ) |>
      summarise(
        .by = case_id,
        across(c(on_oscn, collected), any)
      ),
    by = "case_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(on_oscn, collected), \(x) coalesce(x, FALSE))
  )

district_year_pct <- doc_status |>
  summarise(
    .by = c(district, case_year),
    pct_on_oscn = mean(on_oscn),
    pct_collected = mean(collected)
  )
```

```{r}
#| include: false

document_codes <- ojo_tbl("document", schema = "oscn") |>
  filter(!is.na(docket_id)) |>
  select(docket_id, case_id) |>
  inner_join(
    ojo_tbl("docket", schema = "oscn") |>
      select(docket_id = id, code),
    by = "docket_id"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    ojo_tbl("case", schema = "oscn") |>
      select(case_id = id, district),
    by = "case_id"
  ) |>
  semi_join(
    ojo_tbl("issue", schema = "oscn") |>
      filter(str_detect(description, "^FORC")) |>
      select(case_id),
    by = "case_id"
  ) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
document_status <- eviction_documents |>
  filter(!is.na(url)) |>
  mutate(
    status = ifelse(
      !is.na(internal_url),
      "Collected",
      "On OSCN, not collected"
    )
  ) |>
  count(status) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n))

ggplot(document_status, aes(x = pct, y = status, fill = status)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.05) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Collected" = palette_okpi_main[1],
    "On OSCN, not collected" = palette_okpi_main[2]
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Eviction documents on OSCN",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
case_status <- doc_status |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      collected ~ "Documents collected",
      on_oscn ~ "Documents on OSCN, not collected",
      .default = "No documents on OSCN"
    )
  ) |>
  count(status) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n))

ggplot(case_status, aes(x = pct, y = status, fill = status)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.05) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Documents collected" = palette_okpi_main[1],
    "Documents on OSCN, not collected" = palette_okpi_main[2],
    "No documents on OSCN" = palette_okpi_main[5]
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Document coverage of eviction cases",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
docs_per_case <- eviction_documents |>
  summarise(
    .by = case_id,
    n_documents = sum(!is.na(url))
  ) |>
  count(n_documents, name = "n_cases") |>
  mutate(
    n_documents = ifelse(n_documents >= 10, "10+", as.character(n_documents))
  ) |>
  summarise(
    .by = n_documents,
    n_cases = sum(n_cases)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_documents = factor(n_documents, levels = c(as.character(0:9), "10+"))
  )

ggplot(docs_per_case, aes(x = n_documents, y = n_cases)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = okpi_blue) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Documents per eviction case on OSCN",
    x = "Number of documents",
    y = "Number of cases (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
code_counts <- document_codes |>
  count(code, name = "n_documents") |>
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(desc(n_documents)),
    code_display = ifelse(rank <= 10, as.character(code), "Other")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    .by = code_display,
    n_documents = sum(n_documents)
  ) |>
  mutate(pct = n_documents / sum(n_documents))

ggplot(code_counts, aes(x = pct, y = reorder(code_display, pct))) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = okpi_blue) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)),
    hjust = -0.05
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Docket entry codes on eviction documents",
    subtitle = "Share of documents, by the code of their docket entry",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12

top_codes <- code_counts |>
  filter(code_display != "Other") |>
  slice_max(n_documents, n = 8) |>
  pull(code_display)

district_code_pct <- document_codes |>
  mutate(
    code_display = ifelse(
      as.character(code) %in% top_codes,
      as.character(code),
      "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  count(
    district,
    code_display,
    name = "n_documents"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    .by = district,
    pct = n_documents / sum(n_documents)
  )

ggplot(district_code_pct, aes(x = code_display, y = district, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = okpi_blue,
    name = NULL,
    labels = percent,
    na.value = "grey85"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(
    title = "Docket entry codes on eviction documents, by district",
    subtitle = "Share of each district's documents with each code",
    x = "Docket entry code",
    y = "District"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

```{r}
#| include: false
district_year_pct
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12

plot_coverage_heatmap <- function(data, fill_var, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = case_year, y = district, fill = .data[[fill_var]])) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = okpi_blue,
      name = NULL,
      labels = percent,
      na.value = "grey85"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_width(2)) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Case year",
      y = "District"
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

plot_coverage_heatmap(
  district_year_pct,
  "pct_on_oscn",
  "Share of eviction cases with documents on OSCN, by district and year"
)

plot_coverage_heatmap(
  district_year_pct,
  "pct_collected",
  "Share of eviction cases with documents collected, by district and year"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12

district_status <- doc_status |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      collected ~ "Documents collected",
      on_oscn ~ "Documents on OSCN, not collected",
      .default = "No documents on OSCN"
    )
  ) |>
  summarise(
    .by = c(district, status),
    n_cases = n()
  ) |>
  mutate(
    .by = district,
    pct = n_cases / sum(n_cases)
  )

district_order <- district_status |>
  mutate(
    .by = district,
    pct_collected = sum(pct[status == "Documents collected"])
  ) |>
  distinct(district, pct_collected) |>
  arrange(pct_collected) |>
  pull(district)

ggplot(district_status, aes(x = pct, y = district, fill = status)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = district_order) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Documents collected" = palette_okpi_main[1],
      "Documents on OSCN, not collected" = palette_okpi_main[2],
      "No documents on OSCN" = palette_okpi_main[5]
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Document coverage of eviction cases by district",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
